name: Dr. Nontobeko Mbatha
title: Founder
bio: Dr. Nontobeko Mbatha is a Medical Doctor, CMSA-qualified Histopathologist, Entrepreneur, Podcast Host and passionate Advocate for Patient-centred Healthcare. Born and raised in Ladysmith, KwaZulu-Natal, Dr. Mbatha obtained her Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) from the University of KwaZulu-Natal. She subsequently pursued specialist training in Histopathology, developing a particular passion for Renal Pathology. Dr. Mbatha is the Founder of Tumeladi Diagnostic Pathologists, a pathology laboratory established with a commitment to providing efficient, accurate and reliable diagnostic services with special interest in improving access to histopathology services in Africa via digital pathology solutions. Beyond diagnostic medicine, Dr. Mbatha is passionate about improving communication between healthcare professionals and patients.
